headline: Newegg and the luxury resale site The RealReal are both working with Google on conversational AI shopping, Chain Store Age reports.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: only half of the story (The RealReal, from its own press release) could be checked and Newegg's part is unknown.
importance_line: Shoppers at The RealReal can now ask an AI agent for pieces in plain language, but the benefits are the company's claim and we could not check what Newegg is doing.
summary: Chain Store Age reports that Newegg and The RealReal are teaming with Google on conversational AI shopping, and in a press release on 8 Oct 2026 The RealReal said its Ask TRR agent, built with Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise, is launching to all 45 million members after a pilot.
